subject: Action required: reset your ICT account password
body:
Hello $recipient_name,

Your ICT account requires a password reset. Please use the secure link below to complete the reset before it expires.

[Reset your password]($tracking_url)

This link expires on $link_expiry. If you did not expect this request, contact the ICT service desk.

Education System ICT
